subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers keep waiting on https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252, or replace/adopt it with a maintainer-owned narrow fix because it is conflicting and not maintainer-modifiable?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the only open implementation candidate is outside the target repository's normal maintainer-edit path and cannot merge cleanly right now.

options.title: Replace the uneditable fork PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repository replacement, credit the source PR, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

options.title: Ask the contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it onto current main with maintainer edits enabled if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave the issue and fork PR open until the contributor updates it, accepting that the source-reproducible rendering bug remains unresolved meanwhile.

recommendation.title: Replace the uneditable fork PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow same-repository replacement, credit the source PR, and close the fork PR only after the replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are tied to the affected TUI leading-stripper boundary and are the strongest routing candidate among the relevant history owners.
